# Divine Smite (`spells:divine-smite`)
**Level 1 [Evocation](../magic-schools/evocation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike | **Range:** Self Component: V
**Components:**  | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md)
**Damage Type:** [Radiant](../damage-types/radiant.md)

The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2d8 |
